# Incident with Pull Requests, Git Operations and Issues

## What Changed

Nov 4, 11:50 UTC Resolved - On November 4, 2026, beginning at approximately 09:35 UTC, customers experienced intermittent errors and delays across several GitHub services, including Pull Requests, Issues, APIs, Git operations, and Actions. The disruption was caused by a shared database reaching capacity. We restored service by switching to another database host. Recovery began around 11:24 UTC, and the remaining Actions impact was mitigated by 11:43 UTC. The incident was resolved at 11:50 UTC. We have since made changes to reduce database load, increased capacity, and added monitoring to help identify similar problems earlier. We are also improving our recovery procedures. Nov 4, 11:43 UTC Monitoring - The degradation affecting Actions has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Nov 4, 11:30 UTC Update - The degradation affecting API Requests, Git Operations, Issues and Pull Requests has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Nov 4, 11:17 UTC Update - We're currently working on mitigating elevated errors and intermittent failures affecting GitHub, including Pull Requests, Git Operations, and Issues.
